## In our context

::: {.tip}
- **Regression:** max stress in a bracket or pipe support from geometry and load — a surrogate for a strength calculation
- **Classification:** does a calculated case meet the acceptance criterion (stress below allowable)?
- **Unsupervised:** grouping operating regimes, flagging unusual records in monitoring data
- ML does not replace a qualified calculation code: it speeds up screening and parametric studies
:::
